Defines ScaraDiagnosticSeverity enumeration for SCARA DSL diagnostics.

class scarajectory.core.model.dsl.scara_diagnostic_severity.ScaraDiagnosticSeverity(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]¶

Bases: Enum

Enumeration of diagnostic severity classifications for SCARA DSL analysis.

It defines:

attributes:
ERROR - Critical failure preventing safe code compilation.
WARNING - Potential safety risk or questionable sequencing.
INFO - Optimization hint or stylistic recommendation.
